memos.risk:
Refuse. The coin is down 86% from its 30-minute high and 69% over 30 minutes, with net outflow in the last 15 minutes and sellers outnumbering buyers. Post-graduation sell pressure is nearly even with buying (0.97 sell/buy ratio), and the pool is thin at 43.9 SOL, so a $20 round trip at 1.4-5.1% cost plus slippage on exit could be far worse than quoted. The bundle share (25%) and launch bot presence are warning signs, and the drawdown means we'd be catching a falling knife against a base rate that already loses about 20% per trade.

If the desk insists on a position anyway, the only defensible parameters are a $5 ticket, a 20% stop, and a 15-minute hold, and only after confirming the pool has recovered and sell pressure has turned. Given the current data, the right answer is to skip.
memos.scout:
The brief does not support a buy. The strongest honest points are that the coin is alive, classed ORGANIC, with no airdrop dump seen, 536 buyers, and a fairly distributed holder base (top3 share 7.4%, top5 buyer share 17%). Early post-graduation demand was real: about 301 SOL bought from 467 buyers in the first two minutes.

But the demand has already faded. The 30-minute high has fallen 86%, the 30-minute return is -69%, and the last 15 minutes show -21% with sell SOL (59.0) exceeding buy SOL (55.0) and more sellers (197) than buyers (158). The sell-to-buy ratio of 0.97 over the launch window and a launch bot present both point to early flipping rather than holders. Bundled supply is 25% of the curve, and 40% of the curve was filled by a completer, which is a further overhang. Pool depth of 44 SOL means a $20 round trip faces meaningful impact, and the 30-second execution lag means we would be buying into a still-falling tape.

No honest case exists that real demand will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. Recommendation: skip.
memos.skeptic: The most likely loss is a slow bleed plus fee drag, with a dip that doesn't recover. Net flow over the last 15 minutes is negative (-4.05 SOL), sells (59.03 SOL) nearly match buys (54.98 SOL), and the sell-to-buy ratio of 0.97 in the graduation window suggests early buyers are already exiting. The coin is 69% down over 30 minutes and 86% off its 30-minute high, so buying now is catching a falling knife with no evidence of a floor. Pool depth is thin at 43.89 SOL, so a $20 round trip with 1.4-5.1% costs plus impact will need a sharp rebound to clear. The 25% bundle share and launch bot presence point to coordinated early supply that can still be distributed. Skip.
